<!-- pr-reviewer: 5ccaa66684e5aca1ff19ed83dd9e99bcf0b6478c -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. (Review rule of #3728: no finding, so no class to close.)

## What looks good
- Travel is X 1200, Y 770, Z 88 mm (`-L..L`). This is the smaller value on each axis, as decided. Ooznest's page confirms 770x1270, Z 88 and feed 2500. The owner's 1200 is inside the published 1270.
- The decision record gives a source for each value. It marks the owner's figures (frame, work area, spindle 2.2 kW) as "not public" and says the owner must confirm them.
- I read the Estlcam page for programs from other CAM programs. It confirms the claims used to justify "no post": only G00-G03, no repeated G word omitted, one G and one M per line, I/J arcs only, no full circles, helix allowed, absolute coordinates, no work offset, no cycles, parentheses comments, UTF-8 or ASCII. The file claims no feature beyond this.
- No post and no coolant are stated. Absent Z rates stay absent, not zero. No rpm range is invented.
- Clean-room: only Ooznest, Estlcam and owner sources. No HSMWorks or Autodesk material.
- Picker row and `include_str!` line in `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` agree (file name, display name). The row name matches the `.mch` model and the tests.
- The change adds one data file and tests. No code path of any existing machine changes, so no posted G-code of an existing machine changes.
- Process: ends `Fixes #3038`, has a `Changelog:` line, decision file present, no process file touched, no snapshot PNG, no dependency, no `build.rs`/scripts/`.github`.

## Results merged with main
Run locally in my own worktree. `origin/main` (01e177bf5) was already contained in the head, so the trial merge was empty.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test machine --test machine_library --test axis_direction` | machine 33 passed, machine_library 17 passed (includes `ooznest_workbee_states_the_smaller_envelope_and_feed`), axis_direction 12 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

## Heavy lanes
Not run, as ordered by the dispatcher. The diff adds a data file, a list row and tests only.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- Not checked against the public Estlcam pages: "G20/G21 are ignored" (the page does not name them; it follows from "all other G words are ignored"), "any decimal count", and the M08/M09/M10/M11 output names on the hardware page. These only explain why no post is named. They set no value in the file.
- The `.mch` has `"kind": "mill"`. The Sienci AltMill files have `"kind": "router"`. Both map to Mill in the tests, so this is not a defect.
- X 1200 and the 2.2 kW spindle rest on the owner's statement. The owner must confirm them (the PR body says so).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
